subject.title: refactor(fs): adopt shared safe filesystem primitives

question: Should this protected filesystem-boundary refactor land after a maintainer verifies the shared-helper contracts and the contributor supplies inspectable Zalo QR refresh proof?
rationale: The patch changes secret handling, temporary workspace creation, bounded reads, and root-confined deletion across several owner boundaries; the provided material is not sufficient to independently clear those contracts or the visible QR result.

options.title: Request concrete runtime proof and contract review
options.body: Keep the branch open until a maintainer checks the affected facade contracts and the PR includes redacted after-fix Zalo QR evidence.

options.title: Accept existing automated evidence
options.body: Land based on the reported focused tests, CI, and owner review, accepting that the live QR refresh result is not independently inspectable here.

recommendation.title: Request concrete runtime proof and contract review
recommendation.body: Keep the branch open until a maintainer checks the affected facade contracts and the PR includes redacted after-fix Zalo QR evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied commit history places this contributor closest to the refactor and its Zalo follow-up; a code-area owner should join the final contract review.
